bottleneck.description: Precision photonics, optical encoders, motors and servo drives designed-in to medical, surgical-robot and advanced-industrial OEM platforms with long regulatory/qualification cycles.

dependency.key_customers: Medical device OEMs (Stryker-style surgical robots), industrial laser system makers, semiconductor capital equipment, humanoid/robotics platforms
dependency.key_suppliers: Specialty optics, magnets, semiconductor IC vendors, fabrication subcontractors

editorial.notes: Novanta's component portfolio (encoders, galvo scanners, lasers, servo drives) is heavily designed-in to medical-device and surgical-robot OEM platforms where regulatory revalidation creates multi-year switching cost, similar in spirit to the auto-MCU/ALGM logic. Competition from Coherent, IPG, Lumentum, MicroE and Renishaw exists at the component level, but design-win lifecycles are long and switching is qualification-intensive. Not a sole-source for any critical input, so MEDIUM rather than HIGH.
